    Starters6000 SUX popcornButtery popcorn with a heavy cheese powder dustingHow to make it120g popcorn kernels2 tbsp vegetable oil50g butter, melted4 tbsp cheddar cheese powder1 tsp smoked paprikapinch of saltPop the kernels in the oil in a covered pot, shaking until the popping slows.Toss with the melted butter, then the cheese powder, paprika and salt until every piece is orange.Serve in a big bowl.OCP boardroom canapésSmoked salmon rye and whipped feta cucumber cupsHow to make it4 slices of rye bread20g butter150g smoked salmon100ml crème fraîche1 bunch dill2 Lebanese cucumbers150g feta1 tbsp olive oilButter the rye, cut into squares and top with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill.Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a small hollow in each.Whip the feta with the olive oil until smooth and fill the cucumber cups.Arrange on a platter.Old Detroit pizza squaresOld Detroit, before Delta City goes upHow to make itAs written, serves 4Detroit-style square pizza baked in a hot oiled pan, with cheese right to the edges for a crisp, dark crust and tomato sauce striped on top.Mix 400g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 300ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil, then prove for 1 hour.Press into an oiled 23 x 33cm tin and prove 30 minutes more.Scatter over 100g sliced pepperoni, then 300g cubed mozzarella and 100g cubed cheddar right to the edges.Bake at 250°C for 15 to 18 minutes until the edges are dark and crisp.Stripe warm pizza sauce over the top and cut into 12 squares.Potato and cheese pierogi with sour creamYour move, creep. Pierogi first.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDetroit coney dogFranks with loose coney chilli, mustard and diced onionHow to make it300g beef mince2 onions2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin200ml water8 hot dog franks8 hot dog buns1 bottle yellow mustardDice the onions, keeping half for topping.Brown the mince with half the onion, chilli powder and cumin.Add the water and simmer until loose and saucy.Griddle the franks and steam the buns.Fill the buns with franks and top with chilli, mustard and diced raw onion.Murphy's mushroom soup and cheese toastiesThe baby food paste they feed him at the stationHow to make itAs written, serves 4Silky mushroom soup blitzed with thyme and cream until smooth as paste, served with crisp gruyère and onion toasties for dunking.Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in 40g butter.Add 600g sliced mushrooms and cook 10 minutes until browned.Add 800ml chicken stock and thyme and simmer 20 minutes.Blitz until smooth and stir in 150ml cream.Butter 8 slices sourdough, fill with 150g grated gruyère and thin sliced onion, and toast in a pan for 3 minutes a side.Cut into fingers for dunking.SweetsNukem cupcakesChocolate cupcakes under a torched mushroom-cloud meringueHow to make it125g butter, soft300g caster sugar5 eggs175g self-raising flour30g cocoa125ml full cream milkHeat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole tin. Beat the butter and half the sugar until pale, then beat in two eggs.Fold in the flour, cocoa and milk, divide between the cases and bake.Cool completely.Whisk three egg whites with the remaining sugar over hot water until warm and glossy, then beat to stiff peaks.Pipe tall on each cupcake and torch the tops.DrinksBoddicker's gas station boilermakerIce-cold lager served with a shot of rye whiskey on the side, with a dash of bitters and a lemon twist in the shot.How to make it4 lagers (375ml)120ml rye whiskey4 dashes of aromatic bitters1 lemonChill the lagers and four shot glasses in the freezer.Pour the whiskey into the shot glasses with a dash of bitters and a small lemon twist.Serve each shot alongside a cold lager poured into a chilled glass.Vending machine hot chocolateLewis's shout, for her new partner.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
